story:
AGC Concrete is a Southwest Michigan-based concrete contractor and one of the top concrete construction companies in Macomb County. Our team specializes in residential and commercial concrete work — driveways, patios, walkways, stamped concrete, garage floors, foundation work, repairs, and decorative finishes — using quality materials and reliable craftsmanship on every job.

We're fully licensed and insured, compliant with all local and state requirements, and every project is backed by our best-in-class workmanship warranty. We also offer flexible financing options so a driveway, patio, or foundation project doesn't have to be paid for all at once.

AGC Concrete is rated 4.9 stars across 149 Google reviews, serving Macomb, Clinton Township, Shelby Township, Utica, Washington Township, Sterling Heights, and the surrounding communities within about 30 miles.
